Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 or FIX.4.4 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Microsecond level reso- lution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to TRF ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (Sender- SubID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe does not support PossResend (97) = Y on the TRF system.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that mes- sage was first sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: This field must not be supplied on trade reports to the TRF.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by the TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Traded price. A value of zero or an indicative price may be used if the price is pending, as denoted by TradePriceCondition. This tag may be excluded if using GrossTradeAmt.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity (eg. shares) traded.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional, when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0. Indicates the date and time the trade took place. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Optional. If specified, must match the date component of Transact- Time (60).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Used when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) to identify a specific market. If present must be a valid Reuters exchange code or ISO MIC code. For APA trade reports, may optionally be left blank to use the primary line as designated by Cboe.

Field.Name: GrossTradeAmt
Field.Description: Total amount traded, expressed in units of currency. A value of of zero or an indicative total amount traded price may be used if the price is pending, as denoted by TradePriceCondition. This tag is only considered when LastPx is not specified.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new, a cancellation, an amend- ment or a release. Trades reported under the APA service may be cancelled or amended by the participant. Trades that are currently being delayed from publication can be released for immediate publi- cation. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel 2 = Replace 3 = Release

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. Cboe will enforce port level day- uniqueness. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the TradeReportID matches a live trade report (one that has been acked, but not confirmed or declined), it will be rejected as duplicate.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Where VenueType (1430) = O (offbook), this field models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field, and takes the following values: 1 = Trade Reporting (Off-Exchange) 3 = Trade Reporting (On-Exchange) 9 = Trade Reporting (Systematic Internalizer)

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.1 field ‘Transaction Cat- egory’. 0 = Regular Trade (when none of the following applies) 62 = Dark Trade If TradePriceCondition (1839) = 14 (Trade with Price Improvement) is specified, then the value specified in TrdType (828) will be ignored. Trade with Price Improvement takes precedence above the values listed here.

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.3 field ‘Crossing Trade Indicator’ (ACTX). Agency Cross trades may be indicated by setting TrdSubType (829) = 37. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Bench- mark Indicator’ (BENC). Benchmark trades may be indicated by set- ting SecondaryTrdType (855) = 64. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Must be 0 (Submit)

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Used to specify a previously reported trade to be amended, cancelled or released. Mandatory when TradeReportTransType (487) = 1, 2 or 3, must be absent when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Must be 1 (Two-Party Report)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 4.1 field ’Publication Mode’, and can be used by the participant to request that the publication be delayed. It is ignored if the trade does not qualify for delayed publication. This field may not be amended, however trades currently being de- layed may be released prior to their maximum delay duration using TradeReportTransType (487) = 3. Supported values: 0 = Do Not Publish 1 = Publish trade (immediately) 2 = Deferred Publication

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of venue on which this trade occurred. This field models the MMT Level 1 field ‘Market Mechanism’, and has the following possible values: B = Central Limit Order Book Q = Quote Driven Market D = Dark Order Book O = OffBook A = Periodic Auctions N = Request for Quotes H = Hybrid Market

Field.Name: NoTradePriceConditions
Field.Description: If present, indicates the number of TradePriceCondition (1839) fields.

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate values in MMT v3 levels 3.1, 3.6 and 3.8 For MMT Level 3.1 ‘Transaction Category’: 14 = Trade with Price Improvement (RPRI). TrdType (828) = 0 should be set. For MMT Level 3.6 ‘Special Divided Indicator’, supported values are: 0 = Cum Dividend (deprecated) 2 = Ex Dividend (deprecated) 13 = Special Dividend (SDIV) For MMT Level 3.8 ‘Contribution to Price Formation or the Price Discovery Process’, supported values are: 16 = Trade not Contributing to the Price Discovery Process (TNCP) 17 = Price is Pending (PNDG)

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the method by which the trade was executed. This field corresponds to the proposed MMT Level 3.7 ‘Offbook Automated Liquidity Indicator’. The following values are supported: 0 = Unspecified (default) 1 = Manual 2 = Automated

Field.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates that the submitted trade was a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Optional. 0 = No algorithm was involved (the default). 1 = The trade was an algorithmic trade (ALGO).

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: Optional, to indicate MMT Waivers and Deferrals used for the trade. Valid values are: 0 = Negotiated Trade in Liquid Instrument (for MTF only) (NLIQ) 1 = Negotiated Trade in Illiquid Instrument (for MTF only) (OILQ) 2 = Negotiated Trade Subject to Conditions Other Than Current Market Price (for MTF only) (PRIC) 3 = Reference Price (Dark Book) (for MTF only) (RFPT) 4 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Illiquid Instrument (for SI only) (ILQD) 5 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Above Standard Market Size (for SI only) (SIZE) 6 = Deferral for Large in Scale (LRGS) 7 = Deferral for Illiquid Instrument (for RTS2 only) (ILQD) 8 = Deferral for Size Specific (for RTS2 only) (SIZE) Negotiated Trade Indicators and Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers are MMT Level 3.2 values. Reference Price is a MMT Level 3.5 value. Deferral Reasons are MMT Level 4.1 values. Multiple values can be supplied in a space separated list. Not all combinations are valid. The Negotiated Trade Indicators (NLIQ, OILQ and PRIC) and Refer- ence Price Waiver (RFPT) are MTF Only and are all mutally exclusive (i.e. only one value can be supplied). The Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers ILQD and SIZE are SI Only and can be requested individually or together (e.g. 4 5). The Deferral Reasons can be supplied individually or in a space sep- arated list. LRGS and SIZE are mutually exclusive and so (6 8) is invalid. The business confirmation contains the waiver(s) and deferral(s) that have been appplied.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Mandatory unique ID chosen by client for a Quote or QuoteCancel. 18 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of QuoteID values among currently live quotes. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your QuoteID values day unique.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by the TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Used when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) to identify a specific market. If present must be a valid Reuters exchange code or ISO MIC code. For APA trade reports, may optionally be left blank to use the primary line as designated by Cboe.

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: Specifies the bid quote price. If omitted, indicates the bid quote is not to be changed, and BidSize (134) must also be omitted. If BidPx (132) = 0, indicates the bid quote is to be cancelled, and BidSize (134) = 0 must also be present.

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: Specifies the offer quote price. If omitted, indicates the offer quote is not to be changed, and OfferSize (135) must also be omitted. If OfferPx (133) = 0, indicates the offer quote is to be cancelled, and OfferSize (135) = 0 must also be present.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: The quantity of the bid quote. Must be zero when cancelling a quote.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: The quantity of the offer (ask) quote. Must be zero when cancelling a quote.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Mandatory unique ID chosen by client for a Quote or QuoteCancel. 18 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of QuoteID values among currently live quotes. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your QuoteID values day unique.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Supported values: 1 = Cancel for Symbol 4 = Cancel for All Quotes This field is optional, and defaults to 1. When QuoteCancelType (298) = 4, the request will be acknowledged with one QuoteStatusReport message for each existing quote.

Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Accept) for a confirm, 3 (Decline) for a decline and 0 (Submit) for an unsolicited change.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Id representing the trade, as seen on outbound market data. Allo- cated by Cboe as per the MiFID II definition of a Transaction Iden- tification Code. Required to amend, cancel or release a report.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport.

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: Will be 2 (Deferred Publication) if deferral is requested and the trade is eligible for such. Otherwise, copied from the incoming Trade- CaptureReport.

Field.Description: Copied from the incoming TradeCaptureReport, if present.

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: Indicates the time at which a deferred trade report will be auto- matically published. Where RptTime falls outside of the systems operating time, the report will be published during operating hours on the next trading day. When no deferral is requested, or when the trade does not qualify for a deferral, any time returned will match TransactTime (60). Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: Waiver(s) or deferral(s) used for the trade. If more than one Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver or Deferral has been requested by the Participant and successfully applied by the system, the values will be seperated by a space (e.g. 4 5).

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with the trade. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Copied from the corresponding Quote / QuoteCancel, if applicable. Unsolicited QuoteStatus messages can be sent due to system events, and in such circumstances, QuoteID may be omitted.

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: For valid Quote messages (QuoteStatus (297) = 0 or 1), the new price and size fields are returned in the corresponding QuoteStatus message. These may be zero if there is no applicable quote on this side. Typically, these will match the values sent in the corresponding Quote, unless that Quote message opted to change one side of the quote only.

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: The quote’s offer price, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: The quote’s bid quantity, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: The quote’s offer quantity, or zero. See BidPx (132) for more details.

Field.Name: QuoteStatus
Field.Description: Indicates the acceptance or otherwise of a Quote or QuoteCancel message. 0: Accepted - indicates acceptance of a Quote message. 1: Cancelled - sent in respose to a successful QuoteCancel message. 5: Rejected - sent in respose to a Quote or QuoteCancel message, indicating the message could not be accepted.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates a reason the applicable Quote or QuoteCancel message could not be accepted.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must be first field in repeating-group 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 8 = Cross

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Reflected back on Trade Capture Report confirmed and declined messages. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126).

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be D (Proprietary / Custom Code)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, this field is mandatory on trades reported to the TRF, and must be specified as PartyRole (452) = 7.

Field.Name: NoPartyIDs
Field.Description: Must always be 1

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The Cboe Participant ID (4 uppercase letters).

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Optional. A = Agency P = Principal (default) R = Riskless

Field.Name: TradingSessionSubID
Field.Description: Models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field for scenarios where VenueType (1430) is not ‘O’ (offbook). Use MatchType (574) in- stead, where VenueType (1430) = O. The following are valid values: 2 = Scheduled Opening Auction 4 = Scheduled Closing Auction 6 = Scheduled Intraday Auction 8 = Unspecified Auction 9 = Unscheduled Auction 3 = Continuous Trading 5 = Post Trading 10 = Out of Main Session Trading The tag must be present on the first side, but is optional in any further sides. If specified in further sides, the values used must be identical to that used in the first.

Field.Name: CentralCounterparty
